label: Button Fly
note: Owner-uploaded reference images. Authoritative for construction/appearance; NOT usable as the tech-pack illustration (not line art, or shows multiple options).

references.evidence: Real cloth photograph, not line art. Buttons and matching hand-worked buttonholes down the fly with no zipper tape or teeth anywhere - this is unambiguously a button fly, seen from the inside with the extension open.
references.ownerNotes: it looks goo except there is pant fabric material showing inside the open fly where its should be a tshirt or boxers
